438:t_021:4.en:
$n
「And I'll rescue Miss $$スズネ$$, who gave me that final strength, no matter what!」

438:t_022:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It looks like you've moved beyond $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s shadow too, and opened the final door.」

438:t_023:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
($$太極$$... Come to think of it, the philosophy of $$ジークンドー$$ also...)

438:t_023:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「This is dangerous...! The Age of the Sun is almost here!」

438:t_023:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Did you see that, $$ゲシュタルト$$?! This is our strength... the strength of $c!」

438:t_023:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「The army of darkness, evil Miss $$スズネ$$, $$バアル$$... We'll take care of all of you at once!!」

438:t_024:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「This is... The minds connected by $$ＧＮ粒子$$ are giving each other strength...!」

438:t_024:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「The light in people's hearts... It illuminates the way.」

438:t_024:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We can't afford to lose. Neither can humanity.」

438:t_024:6.en:
$n
(The moment $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ was born... I... felt everything...)

438:t_024:7.en:
$n
(Everything in this world... has a heart... It lends me... lends us strength...)

438:t_024:8.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「The $$いがみ合う双子$$ and $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$! I'll make all that power mine!」

438:t_024:9.en:
$n
「Light and darkness, hope and despair... The place I have to reach lies beyond them...!」

438:t_024:10.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! I'm coming for you now!!」

438:t_025:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「I confirm that combat has ended.」

438:t_025:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then we're safe for the moment.」

438:t_026:1.en:
$n
「No, not yet. I can't celebrate until I've saved Miss $$スズネ$$ and taken back Earth.」

438:t_026:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's good to set your sights high.」

438:t_026:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「Well then... Let's head back and give $$ＡＧ$$ and $$クロウ$$ what they deserve.」

438:t_026:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Of course. It's fortunate it worked, but that gamble was far too dangerous.」

438:t_026:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$クロウ$$ and $$ＡＧ$$ are both scared of Dr. $$トライア$$. Should we tell on them?」

438:t_026:10.en:
$n
「I'm grateful to both you and $$ＡＧ$$, $$クロウ$$.」

438:t_026:11.en:
$n
「Of course, I want to thank everyone else too.」

438:t_026:14.en:
$n
(And someday... I'll thank you too, Miss $$スズネ$$.)

438:t_026:15.en:
$n
(For everything until now, for today... And for what lies ahead...)

438:t_027:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「I've seen your power.」

438:t_027:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Wait, $$ゲシュタルト$$! What are you fighting for?!」

438:t_027:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Isn't it obvious? We fight for this universe.」

438:t_027:4.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「We'll meet again, $c. Next time, I'll come with my friend, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$.」

438:t_028:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! I never want to see your damn face again!」

438:t_028:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$タケル$$... What did $$ゲシュタルト$$ mean by fighting for the universe...?」

438:t_028:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Perhaps they're trying to use Earth's power to fight $$バアル$$ too...」

438:t_029:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I've seen $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$'s power.」

438:t_029:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「$n... You may think you've overcome despair, but the wounds your mother gave you are still inside you.」

438:t_029:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「They can easily swallow you whole. Can you resist?」

438:t_029:5.en:
$n
「I won't give in to threats like that.」

438:t_029:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That's the spirit. Perfect $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ before we meet again.」

438:t_029:7.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That machine is meant for me!」

438:t_030:2.en:
$n
「To save Miss $$スズネ$$, I have to shatter her confidence.」

438:t_030:3.en:
$n
「The only way to do that is to defeat her completely.」

438:t_100:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「$$マーズ$$...! I'll crush you before you awaken to your true power!」

438:t_100:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「It must never exist! If things go wrong, it could disrupt even the laws of the universe!」

438:t_100:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Even so, I can't just let you kill me!」

438:t_100:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「Here I come, $$ゲシュタルト$$! I'll beat you, then I'll beat $$ズール$$!」

438:t_101:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「More, $n! Show me more of $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$'s power!」

438:t_101:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「With that power, I could even rise to the top of $$サイデリアル$$!」

438:t_101:2.en:
$n
「This is my fighting strength! It has nothing to do with you!」

438:t_101:3.en:
$n
「No... Let me correct that. It's also the power I'll use to drive you out of Miss $$スズネ$$!」

438:t_101:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You've got some nerve! You mommy's boy!」

438:t_101:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Then I'll beat you utterly and throw you into the abyss of despair again!」

438:t_102:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're persistent, $n! You still haven't given up?!」

438:t_102:1.en:
$n
「If you were inside Miss $$スズネ$$ too, you should know how hard it is to make me give up!」

438:t_102:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「That's true. I've finally realized what a pain you are to have as an enemy.」

438:t_102:4.en:
$n
「Whatever hardships await me, I'll move forward and follow my heart!」

438:t_102:5.en:
$n
「I'll transcend both convenient hope and the despair that corrupts everything!!」
